description: This file defines the IMiracastService interface and related enums and structures for Miracast service functionality within the WPEFramework. It includes method declarations for managing Miracast connections, player states, and notifications.

classes.name: IMiracastService
classes.description: Interface for Miracast service operations, including connection management, player state updates, and notifications.

classes.name: IMiracastService::DeviceParameters
classes.description: Structure holding source and sink device IP and MAC addresses, and device name.

classes.name: IMiracastService::Result
classes.description: Structure indicating success or failure message for operations.

classes.name: IMiracastService::INotification
classes.description: Interface for Miracast event notifications such as connection requests and errors.

methods.name: GetEnabled
methods.description: Retrieve current enabled status of Miracast feature.

methods.name: AcceptClientConnection
methods.description: Accept or reject a client connection request.

methods.name: UpdatePlayerState
methods.description: Update the player state for a client.

methods.name: SetP2PBackendDiscovery
methods.description: Set the backend discovery status for P2P.
